represents: Human and legacy-automation access to one AWS account: developers and SREs using long-term IAM-user access keys (AKIA) from the corporate VPN / office NAT (203.0.113.32/27, 203.0.113.48/28, own IPv6) AND from home ISP connections off VPN (192.0.2.0/26) for sts get-caller-identity, MFA get-session-token and read-only Describe/List calls; the MFA-authenticated temporary sessions (ASIA) of those IAM users; IAM-user console sign-ins and console page loads; IAM Identity Center users (the majority) working from home; a legacy CI job with a stored IAM-user key on GitHub-hosted runners; an on-prem backup agent; and a third-party cost-optimisation SaaS polling with a read-only IAM-user key from its own egress (192.0.2.112/28).
provenance: synthetic; shapes from the AWS CloudTrail record contents and userIdentity reference (IAMUser with long-term and session credentials, sessionCredentialFromConsole), the CloudTrail ConsoleLogin / AwsConsoleSignIn reference, STS GetSessionToken, the S3 data-event reference, and this repo's TRR9012 fixtures. Long-term keys are AKIAEXAMPLE<id> (20 chars), sessions ASIAEXAMPLE<digits>; user names are role handles, not people; account 123456789012; addresses RFC 5737 / 2001:db8::/32.
